info.title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
info.synopsis: Dopo essere stato trasportato in un altro mondo, nel regno magico di Klyrode, come candidato futuro eroe, Banaza si ritrova squalificato dal ruolo in quanto dotato solamente delle abilità di comune cittadino. Inoltre a causa di un errore del regno magico, invece di essere rimandato nel suo mondo si trova intrappolato a Klyrode. Con il raggiungimento del Livello 2, Banaza acquisisce capacità e magia fino a diventare un super cheat e superare ogni limite, ma sempre con il sorriso sulle labbra e con semplicità!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Banaza, a merchant, has doubts about a world with racial discrimination. One day, he's summoned to The Magical Kingdom of Klyrode in another world as a hero candidate. However, his level 1 abilities and stats are on par with those of ordinary citizens.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Banaza, a merchant, has doubts about a world with racial discrimination. One day, he's summoned to The Magical Kingdom of Klyrode in another world as a hero candidate. However, his level 1 abilities and stats are on par with those of ordinary citizens.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Banaza has begun his new life as Flio, but right off the bat, he's challenged by Fenrys, the sister of a member of the Dark One's Infernal Four. Flio knows he can't beat such a powerful foe in physical combat, so he starts testing out his new spells...

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: Banaza has begun his new life as Flio, but right off the bat, he's challenged by Fenrys, the sister of a member of the Dark One's Infernal Four. Flio knows he can't beat such a powerful foe in physical combat, so he starts testing out his new spells...

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: With Fenrys as his wife, Flio begins his new life in this new world. Balirossa and three of her fellow knights end up living with them, as well. Life is peaceful for Flio and his new companions, but a dark figure is watching them from the shadows...

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: With Fenrys as his wife, Flio begins his new life in this new world. Balirossa and three of her fellow knights end up living with them, as well. Life is peaceful for Flio and his new companions, but a dark figure is watching them from the shadows...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Balirossa is disappointed that she was of no help in the Dark Army's attack on Flio and Fenrys. As she's training on her own in the forest to get stronger, a mysterious man approaches and says he's looking for an old friend...

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: Balirossa is disappointed that she was of no help in the Dark Army's attack on Flio and Fenrys. As she's training on her own in the forest to get stronger, a mysterious man approaches and says he's looking for an old friend...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: As Flio and company are beginning their new life near the town of Houghtow, an all-out attack by the Dark Army endangers Klyrode's very existence, forcing the king to make a decision.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: As Flio and company are beginning their new life near the town of Houghtow, an all-out attack by the Dark Army endangers Klyrode's very existence, forcing the king to make a decision.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Hiya, the djinn who commands the origin of light and darkness, appears out of nowhere and attacks Flio. Fenrys is gravely injured protecting him, sending the normally peaceful Flio into a rage as he unleashes his own immense power upon Hiya.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: Hiya, the djinn who commands the origin of light and darkness, appears out of nowhere and attacks Flio. Fenrys is gravely injured protecting him, sending the normally peaceful Flio into a rage as he unleashes his own immense power upon Hiya.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Hiya is assigned general housework duty, making Balirossa and her companions worry that they'll be reduced to freeloaders who contribute nothing to the household. Meanwhile, a witch who was sealed along with Hiya shows up in Houghtow...

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: Hiya is assigned general housework duty, making Balirossa and her companions worry that they'll be reduced to freeloaders who contribute nothing to the household. Meanwhile, a witch who was sealed along with Hiya shows up in Houghtow...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: When Balirossa confides that Gholl has been appearing in her dreams, her three fellow knights smell love in the air. Meanwhile, Gholl halts his army's advance to try to recruit Flio, a decision that not all demons are happy with...

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: When Balirossa confides that Gholl has been appearing in her dreams, her three fellow knights smell love in the air. Meanwhile, Gholl halts his army's advance to try to recruit Flio, a decision that not all demons are happy with...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The princess has learned that Flio's true identity is Banaza. She pays him a visit to apologize for the unfair treatment he's received from the kingdom, and to ask him to protect small towns from the Dark Army as the true hero.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis: The princess has learned that Flio's true identity is Banaza. She pays him a visit to apologize for the unfair treatment he's received from the kingdom, and to ask him to protect small towns from the Dark Army as the true hero.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Gholl's younger brother, Yuigarde, has staged an insurrection. At his castle, Gholl learns that even the Infernal Four are dissatisfied with his recent actions, and Yuigarde challenges him to a duel with the Dark One's throne on the line.

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis: Gholl's younger brother, Yuigarde, has staged an insurrection. At his castle, Gholl learns that even the Infernal Four are dissatisfied with his recent actions, and Yuigarde challenges him to a duel with the Dark One's throne on the line.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Fenrys wins a hot springs resort trip in the town lottery, so Flio and company head to the hot springs. They all enjoy the resort in their own way without realizing that the Dark Army's top officials are staying there as well...

tmdb.title: Episodio 11

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Flio and his friends have arrived at the hot spring where they encounter the Demon King's group and the Golden-haired Hero who's transformed and chaos ensues. While Flio and his friends fight to save the town, Gholl faces off against Yuigarde.
